const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""RoboLab limited-mode glasses pickup trajectory.
+
+Run from the live rcb-limited service with ``PYTHONPATH=/opt/tools python /app/output/gen.py``.
+The episode is not reset between invocations.  Each completed motion chunk is saved under
+/app/runs for review.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="frames")
+obs.save(str(OUT / "gen_start"))
+p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+q_down = p[11:15].copy()  # reset orientation: fingertips point down
+
+def move(position, name, gripper=0.0):
+    target = np.r_[np.asarray(position, dtype=float), q_down, float(gripper)]
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", target[None, :], video="both", video_fps=10)
+    res.save(str(OUT / name))
+    print(name, "done=", res.meta.get("done"), "plan=", res.meta.get("plan"),
+          "tcp=", res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", []) [8:15], flush=True)
+    return res
+
+# Safe overhead route to the eyeglasses center estimated from calibrated RGB-D.
+move((0.355, 0.14, 0.30), "glasses_waypoint_1")
+move((0.355, 0.28, 0.30), "glasses_overhead")
+obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="both", video_fps=10)
+obs.save(str(OUT / "glasses_overhead_obs"))
+print("time_left_s=", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), "tcp=", obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15], flush=True)
